import pandas as pd


def normalize_prices(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    return df["price"] / df["price"].max()


def add_full_name(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    return df["first_name"] + " " + df["last_name"]


def label_premium(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df["premium_discount"] = df["total_spent"] * 0.1
    df.loc[df["total_spent"] <= 1000, "premium_discount"] = 0.0
    return df


def transform_scores(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df["normalized"] = (df["score"] - df["score"].mean()) / df["score"].std()
    return df
